reason.description: one or two sentences: why act now, or why silence

intent.description: short snake_case label of what this message is for, e.g. commitment_walk, meal_check, plan_ahead, reengage, weekly_reflection, ask_missing_info

commitment_id.description: id of the commitment this message is about, if any

message.description: what to say; for a call: why you are calling, in one short sentence (shown on the incoming-call screen and used to open the call)

next_check_reason.description: what you will be looking for then

commitment_outcomes.description: Only when new_observations clearly show that a commitment was done or skipped (with the evidence).
